features.name: Hunter's Charge
features.description: Once per turn, if you move at least 10 feet toward a target and hit it with a melee weapon attack in the same turn, you can use a bonus action to attack that creature with your Cat's Claws. Uses = proficiency bonus per day. Regain on long rest.

payload.name: Hunter's Charge
payload.description: After moving 10 ft toward a target and hitting with a melee attack, use a bonus action to make an additional Cat's Claws attack.

features.name: One With the Wilds
features.description: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Insight, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.

choices.name: Wilds Skill
choices.description: Choose Insight, Medicine, Nature, or Survival.
